canDoYue: 你識講頭班機延遲、趕唔切去東京嘅轉機、改簽同一班、行李轉運、三十蚊代用券、二十二號閘口，同埋拎新登機證。
canDoEn: Say the first flight was delayed and the Tokyo connection was missed, rebook with the bag on the same flight at nine tonight, take a thirty-dollar voucher, and collect a new boarding pass for gate twenty-two.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello there. My first flight was badly delayed overseas, and I've missed my afternoon connection to Tokyo airport.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。頭班機喺外地嚴重延遲，我趕唔切去東京機場嘅轉機。
dialogue.say: Hello there. My first flight was badly delayed overseas, and I've missed my afternoon connection to Tokyo airport.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that delay. The next flight to Tokyo leaves at nine tonight. Let me check.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思。我睇一下。下一班去東京嘅航班今晚九點。
dialogue.say: I'm sorry about that delay. The next flight to Tokyo leaves at nine tonight. Let me check.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you rebook me on that same flight? And will my checked bag transfer with me too?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以幫我改簽同一班？寄艙行李會唔會一齊轉運？
dialogue.say: Can you rebook me on that same flight? And will my checked bag transfer with me too?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes, I rebook you on it. Your checked bag will transfer on that same flight too.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，我幫你改簽。你嘅寄艙行李會上同一班。
dialogue.say: Yes, I rebook you on it. Your checked bag will transfer on that same flight too.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: It's a long wait until nine. Can I get a hot meal voucher while my bag is here?
dialogue.glossYue: 要等到九點。我可唔可以拎張熱食代用券，等我個袋喺度？
dialogue.say: It's a long wait until nine. Can I get a hot meal voucher while my bag is here?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes, here's a hot meal voucher for thirty dollars. You can use it at any cafe here.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，呢張熱食代用券三十蚊。你喺任何咖啡店用得。
dialogue.say: Yes, here's a hot meal voucher for thirty dollars. You can use it at any cafe here.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Can I use the meal voucher at the gate, and where is my new boarding pass?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。我可唔可以喺閘口用代用券，新登機證喺邊？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Can I use the meal voucher at the gate, and where is my new boarding pass?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Gate twenty-two is your only departure gate. Here's your new printed boarding pass right now please.
dialogue.glossYue: 閘口二十二。呢張新登機證你攞住。
dialogue.say: Gate twenty-two is your only departure gate. Here's your new printed boarding pass right now please.
